content:
I no longer have access to the email address I was using on the nForum and I don't remember the password associated to it. I would like to create a new account to be able to post on the nForum Zulip but an invitation is needed.

Can anyone send me such an invitation?
Me too, I was certain that I remembered the password but didn't. If anyone can also send me an invitation, I would appreciate a lot...

The old nForum used usernames, while the new one uses email. This worked for me:

1) Use "Forgot password"
2) Enter your email to reset your password, go to your mail box and reset your password (you can use your old one I guess)
3) When you login make sure you use your email address and not your username
4) Accept the admin acknowledgement (after logging in) and your are in
Thanks Rémy! I couldn't do that because the email account I used has been deactivated. But someone here helped my by DM
I would also like an invite if possible - in my case not because I lost access, but because I didn't have an account in the first place and would like to create one. Thanks in advance :)
The settings were recently updated, you should be able to create an account now without an invitation.
